name: Southern beech forest
description: Southern beech forest - the Nothofagus cluster (nire, lenga, coihue, roble, coigue de Chiloe) with its mistletoe Misodendrum, the understorey fern Blechnum and dwarf cypress Lepidothamnus fonckii. Functional group pooling 8 source nodes; the source study itself merges the five Nothofagus species into a bundled node wherever diet studies did not distinguish them (its >50% diet-resolution rule), and browsers feed on seedlings and saplings.
